name: 90713 · Lakewood, CA
findings: ZIP 90713 (Lakewood) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90713 (Lakewood) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 90713 (Lakewood) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
